name: Symphony Ltd
title: Symphony Ltd - 517385 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Symphony's Q2 standalone EBITDA margin held near 13% with asset-light launches of RAC, BLDC fans and purifiers, but no hard numbers were given and the Australia capital guidance was not addressed.

summary.headline: Symphony Q2 FY27 consol revenue rose 31% to ₹275 crore and EBITDA nearly tripled to ₹36 crore, with EBITDA margin at 13% vs 6.4%.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 31% YoY to ₹275 crore and EBITDA rose to ₹36 crore from ₹13 crore, despite gross margin falling about 4%. Standalone revenue rose to ₹170 crore from ₹155 crore, with standalone EBITDA of ₹30 crore vs ₹27 crore, while standalone gross margin fell about 2.3%. Management said Beyond India Summer Products (BISP) now make up 51% of consolidated top line, with a high-single-digit EBITDA margin. The company announced a second interim dividend of ₹2 per share, taking FY27 interim payouts to ₹3 per share (about ₹21 crore so far), and said it will enter room air conditioners, BLDC ceiling fans and air purifiers on an asset-light, outsourced model.

segments.name: BISP (Beyond India Summer Products), consolidated
segments.commentary: ₹625 crore top line, 51% of consolidated revenue; includes LSV, geysers, tabletop fans, India exports and overseas subsidiary sales. EBITDA margin in high single digits; each product category EBITDA positive.

segments.name: BISP, standalone
segments.commentary: ₹192 crore trailing 12-month revenue (24% of standalone); EBITDA around 10%.

segments.name: IMPCO Mexico
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue ₹40 crore vs ₹17 crore YoY; June quarter hit by delayed summer, partly recovered in Q2.

segments.name: Australia and USA combined
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue about ₹46 crore vs about ₹35 crore YoY. Brazil and USA also grew YoY in a non-seasonal quarter; figures not separately disclosed.

segments.name: D2C channel
segments.commentary: Management says EBITDA and PAT positive, PAT positive from second year onwards; contribution not disclosed.

segments.name: Air coolers (standalone)
segments.commentary: Gross margin 45.9% at quarter end, 2.3 points lower YoY; management expects margins broadly unchanged going forward.

guidance_outlook: No capex or specific opex for the three new categories (RAC, BLDC fans, air purifiers) in Q3; no advertising planned this quarter. Some brand spend may come in summer 2027, kept small enough to stay EBITDA accretive.

New categories to be launched in the December quarter: about 7 BLDC ceiling fan models, 2 air purifier models, and room air conditioners. RAC and BLDC fans are zero capex; air purifiers may need small capex later.
Air conditioner and fan margins expected lower than air coolers because industry margins are lower; air purifiers expected between coolers and ACs.
Management said standalone EBITDA margin in H2 FY27 should be somewhat better than H1's 14.4%, driven mainly by coolers. Management did not give a blended FY27 margin range.
Management said it does not target a top-three position in new categories. It aims to add to top line and EBITDA, with measured brand investment.
Dividend policy is fixed by a Board-approved policy and is not expected to change.
capex_capacity: Asset-light, outsourced model for the new categories. Management said there is no captive manufacturing plan for now, but it is open to it if scale justifies it.

Air conditioners are to be priced in the mid-premium segment, with specs above entry-level and comparable to Voltas and Samsung on like-for-like features. Management said it will not compete with Daikin, Mitsubishi or Hitachi.
Outsourcing partner for BLDC fans already finalised; products to roll out soon.
Management said initial distribution is through the GT (general trade) channel, with organized retail to follow. Channel finance is planned to minimise working capital.
Launch to start in one market, then expand pan-India over about a year.
demand_pricing: Channel inventory was normalised after the June quarter; management says company inventory was minimal at end-Q1. Q3 production is building fresh channel stock for summer 2027, not residual stock.
Management said a normal summer should drive good sales across cooling categories because the channel is clean. Demand depends on temperature; El Niño was called unpredictable.

International: Middle East disruption stalled some shipments despite advance payments, and freight costs rose. Tariffs add uncertainty. Management aspires to healthy international CAGR but gave no figure.
Analyst's 30-40% international CAGR framing was not endorsed. Management said growth is aspirational and uncertain.
Management cited a TAM of about ₹50,000 crore in RAC, versus the ₹5,000 crore it quoted for the category earlier; it gave no revenue target.
Competition: management said new cooler entrants win trade space through product breadth; it sees no cannibalisation of coolers from RAC.

qa_highlights.question: Will the new category launches carry upfront opex, marketing or distribution spend in the December quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no capex and no specific opex for the new products in the quarter. Existing sales team will sell them and no advertising is planned this quarter. Brand spend may come around summer, kept measured.

qa_highlights.question: How big could the new categories become, and what are the internal targets?
qa_highlights.answer: Management gave no number. It said it is taking baby steps and will grow cautiously so the categories stay EBITDA accretive, with no delusions of being a top player.

qa_highlights.question: Why enter low-margin RAC when top players struggle with margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said rivals have captive manufacturing, while Symphony's model is purely variable cost with no fixed investment. Trade channel year-round engagement is expected to spill over to coolers.

qa_highlights.question: What are channel and company inventory levels?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said channel normalisation is largely complete. Company inventory was minimal at end-June. Current channel stock is fresh inventory for summer 2027.

qa_highlights.question: What is the expected working capital need for the new products?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the model is low working capital. Products will be bought and sold on demand with no large inventory build, so ROCE should be good.

qa_highlights.question: What is the pricing for residential ACs and cannibalisation risk for coolers?
qa_highlights.answer: Mid-premium pricing with higher specs, comparable to Voltas or Samsung on like-for-like features. Management sees no cannibalisation and expects channel expansion to help coolers.

qa_highlights.question: What share of revenue is D2C and how much does the USA/Mexico/Australia business contribute?
qa_highlights.answer: Management does not give channel-wise splits for D2C; it says D2C has been PAT positive since its second year. IMPCO Mexico ₹40 crore, GSK China ₹23 crore, Australia and USA together ₹46 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA margin should be expected in FY27 on a blended basis?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said blended margin for FY27 should be higher than the 13-15% range suggested by the analyst, since coolers still dominate sales. It said H2 standalone EBITDA margin should be somewhat above H1's 14.4%.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from input costs: consolidated gross margin down about 4%, standalone about 2.3%; coolers at 45.9% gross margin.
New categories (RAC, BLDC fans, air purifiers) face competition from established brands; scale and margin accretion are unproven, and no targets were given.
Dependence on the outsourced manufacturing partner and on summer 2027 weather; El Niño impact is uncertain.
International business exposed to Middle East disruption, freight cost increases and tariffs. Some advance-paid orders could not be shipped.
Standalone PAT down YoY in H1 (₹57 crore vs ₹65 crore). Management attributes the gap to forex, treasury and exceptional items, not core business.
Management said it may move to captive manufacturing if scale justifies it; this would change the asset-light model.
key_quotes: At this moment, we really do not have a specific number that we can share.
It is fresh inventory that has been built up for the summer of 2027. It is not residual inventory from 2025 or 2024 as we had in 2026.
But I wouldn't really bank on El Niño lifting all boats.
Because of all the uncertainties, it is difficult to give a figure. But yes, we have aspir ations to grow at a healthy CAGR for the international business.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on the Q2 numbers, BISP de-risking and the asset-light entry into RAC, BLDC fans and air purifiers, but cautious and evasive on quantified targets: it gave no revenue or margin targets for the new categories, declined to share a number for international CAGR, and said captive manufacturing or the long-term model depends on how things evolve.

adds.what: Outsourced launch of ~7 BLDC ceiling fan models, 2 air purifier models and room air conditioners (asset-light, no captive plant)

growth.why: Q2 consolidated revenue +31% and standalone EBITDA guided to be somewhat better in H2 than H1's 14.4% margin, backed mainly by coolers; no numeric FY27 revenue guidance, and new categories are outsourced with launches in the December quarter, with a clean channel for summer 2027 but no revenue target.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guided standalone EBITDA margin in H2 FY27 to be somewhat better than H1's 14.4%, driven mainly by coolers, though coolers' gross margin fell to 45.9% (2.3 points lower YoY) and new categories carry lower margins.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Asset-light outsourced model for RAC, BLDC fans and air purifiers with no captive plant planned; no capex for RAC or BLDC fans, only possible small capex for air purifiers later.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Channel inventory normalised, Q3 production building fresh stock for summer 2027, and standalone revenue rose to ₹170 crore from ₹155 crore (+10%) with new launches in the December quarter; no volume numbers were given.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management said there is no captive manufacturing plan for now and no capex for the new categories in Q3; no utilisation figure was disclosed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numeric FY27 revenue or margin guidance was given, so there is no guided base to raise.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Consolidated gross margin fell about 4% and standalone about 2.3%, international shipments were stalled by Middle East disruption and freight costs, and summer 2027 depends on El Niño.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: About 7 BLDC ceiling fan models, 2 air purifier models and room air conditioners to launch in the December quarter, with the BLDC fan outsourcing partner already finalised.

rows.label: RAC and BLDC fan roll-out, one market then pan-India
rows.why: Launch starts in one market and expands pan-India over about a year, with GT channel first and channel finance planned to limit working capital; TAM cited at ₹50,000 crore for RAC, but no revenue target given.

rows.label: Mid-premium RAC pricing with no cannibalisation of coolers
rows.why: Management prices ACs mid-premium, comparable to Voltas and Samsung, and sees no cannibalisation of coolers; AC margins expected below coolers because industry margins are lower.

rows.label: Interim dividend and treasury deployment
rows.why: Second interim dividend of ₹2 per share (₹13 crore payout) takes FY27 interim to ₹3 per share (about ₹21 crore so far), funded from ₹468 crore treasury after repaying Australia borrowings.
